title: The Echo of the Kuiper Line Again
author: Rosalind Halloran
blurb: Noor Villalobos, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
